purpose: HTRU2 migration development validation, not confirmatory thesis evidence
budget_rule: Feasible equal-fold mean F1 >= full baseline - epsilon; minimize mean actual rho*k/d, then k, then maximize mean F1, then frozen candidate order; staged tolerance 1e-12
sequential_rule: Select method/rho using all features under the same full-baseline threshold, then select feature parameters within that method under that same threshold
timing: Shared development search package; deduplicated subsets within method/partition; report actual fits and work, not independent per-arm runtime claims
